entities.name: Hafsa bint al-Hajj al-Rukuniyya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ḥafṣa bint al-Ḥājj ar-Rakūniyya was an aristocrat and poet of 12th century Granada, recognized as the last major female poet from al-Andalus and one of the most celebrated female poets of Andalusi literature. She is also remembered as a teacher in the Almohad court; Ibn al-Khatib later described her as ustādhat waqtihā.
